title: Nervous to natural - a great photoshoot
text: I had a wonderful experience with Anna. She was incredibly nice, kind, and patient throughout the entire shoot. She was very creative with poses and always asked for my input, which made me feel comfortable. I’m not good in front of a camera and by the end I forgot that we were taking pictures. I was tense at the beginning, but her supportive approach helped me have fun. I’m glad I worked with her and would absolutely recommend her. I hope she works in Iceland on my next vacation!
author: Kenneth_B
